name: usage-bar
description: Context, 5h and weekly usage as bars above the prompt, colored by how close each is to its limit, with a Compact button.

contextWarnPercent.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPercent.description: Context bar turns orange at this percent of the window.

contextAlertPercent.title: Context alert (%)
contextAlertPercent.description: Context bar turns red, shows ⚠ and raises a toast at this percent.

limitWarnPercent.title: Usage limit warning (%)
limitWarnPercent.description: 5h and weekly bars turn orange at this percent.

limitAlertPercent.title: Usage limit alert (%)
limitAlertPercent.description: 5h and weekly bars turn red and show ⚠ at this percent.
